Jordan Lee: Following the postmortem todaywe need a compact list of follow-ups for the vendor/auth/model-registry cascade. Opening thread to capture owners + deadlines.
Priya Nair: I'll coordinate the action tracker. Short list idea: 1) model client circuit-breaker + retry policy 2) auth grace window & TTL safety 3) provider region routing and escalation contacts 4) quarterly dependency drills. Who volunteers?
Marco Alvarez: I'll take #1 (circuit-breaker). Plan: add resilience layer in model-client lib with backoff + fail-open to local cached model weights for 60s. PR with tests by Wed. Config snippet: 
```
circuit_breaker:
  fail_threshold: 5
  open_duration: 60s
  retry_backoff: exponential
```
Tess can help validate.
Tess Howard: Happy to help. Also will run the local-weight failover test in staging during the week.
Riley Park: I'll own #2 (auth). Proposal: implement a 5m TTL grace and rotate tokens earlier (rotate at 80% of life), plus an audit that flags tokens with <10% lifetime remaining under load. Will draft runbook and add KMS steps. Target: draft by Tue.
Jordan Lee: #3 (provider routing): propose two concrete mitigations(1) prefer multi-region endpoints for model-registry where available, (2) fallback routing to secondary provider pool on 4xx/5xx surge. Also request vendor escalation path be added to vendor-cabinet and vendor-SLA doc updated. Who can own?
Priya Nair: I'll take vendor contact updates and SLA doc edits. Will request account team to add escalation phone + on-call contacts. Target: EOW.
Marco Alvarez: small noteour logs showed a spike of 500s from provider region-us-west-2 before auth tokens started failing. Suggest we add a tracing-ID correlation between auth failures and provider 5xx to detect cascade earlier. I'll add correlation keys to model-client logs.
OpsBot: Incident IR-2026-045 created: https://redwood.incidents/IR-2026-045. Runbook draft: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/vendor-mitigation. Severity P1, impact ~1.5% peak, time ~45m.
Tess Howard: For dependency drills (#4), recommend a 2hr disruption window simulating provider 5xx + auth delay. Include SRE, Core-API, SDK, and Support. Suggest next Sprint week.
Riley Park: Also adding a monitoring alert: model_client.provider_5xx_rate > 0.7% for 3m -> open incident, trigger canary route. I'll put this into the alerts queue and own implementation.
Priya Nair: Collating owners: Marco -> circuit-breaker + logging correlation (PR Wed); Riley -> auth grace & runbook (draft Tue); Priya -> vendor contacts + SLA update (EOW); Tess -> staging drills + validation (slot next sprint); Jordan -> stakeholder comms + QA of runbook. I'll create tracker doc and run a weekly 10-min sync starting next Wed. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-vendor-remediate.
Jordan Lee: Acceptance criteria: circuit-breaker merged + canary showing failover, auth-runbook dry-run executed successfully in staging, vendor-SLA updated with escalation contacts, and a drill scheduled. After all items DONE we'll schedule a post-closure retro to capture follow-ons.
Marco Alvarez: I'll post PR link here when ready.
Tess Howard: Will schedule the staging slot and ping SRE.
Priya Nair: Adding a noteask legal to review SLA language for escalation obligations. I'll loop them in.
Riley Park: FYI tagging this under recurring-deps so it shows up in the quarterly ops review.
Jordan Lee: Great. If blockers pop up, drop them in #eng-oncall. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
